info.name: Glass frosted for IG
info.description:
Transform Instagram Web into a sleek, frosted-glass wonderland. This userstyle applies soft blurred panels and semi-transparent overlays across headers, sidebars, posts, and story cards, giving the site a smooth “icy” look while keeping text and icons readable. Subtle gradients, rounded corners, and a light, airy wallpaper background complete the glassy vibe. Perfect for users who want Instagram to feel modern, soft, and stylish.

Features:

Frosted-glass effect on headers, sidebars, posts, and stories

Adjustable blur, opacity, and saturation via CSS variables

Soft, light-colored background with subtle gradients

Maintains readability for text and icons

Works on desktop and mobile web views
